who_may_file.conditions: Property owner or lessee may be issued an electrical permit; property owner doing the work or hiring different contractors must sign and upload Owner-Builder Verification Form (DS-3042) before permit issuance.

requirements.item: Submit service request through SDG&E My Project Center with scope, site plans, and load calculations

requirements.item: Obtain service and meter location from SDG&E for new services, relocations, and service upgrades

requirements.item: Submit solar/battery interconnection application via SDG&E DIIS Online Application Portal

requirements.item: Set up billing account and complete local AHJ inspections prior to energization

requirements.item: SDG&E performs final inspection, testing, and meter set before energization
requirements.quote: We'll do a final inspection, complete testing, and set the meter.

requirements.item: Apply for Change to Existing Service for renovations or upgrades changing electrical power needs
requirements.quote: Change to Existing Service. The property already has a meter. You're doing a renovation or upgrade that significantly changes the electrical or gas power needs.

requirements.item: Submit online service request with current and proposed panel size and additional loads
requirements.quote: For electric service, current and proposed panel size and additional loads.

requirements.item: Obtain SDG&E approval before energizing solar PV systems after City final inspection
requirements.quote: After receiving final inspection approval for all related City of San Diego Approvals (permits), San Diego Gas and Electric (SDG&E) will be notified. The system is not approved to energize until SDG&E approval is obtained.

checklist.title: Information Bulletin 301 - How to Obtain a Permit for the Installation of Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Systems

requirements.item: Building Construction Plans incorporating all elements of the Residential Solar PV Project Plan Template
requirements.quote: Review the Residential Solar PV Project Plan Template and incorporate all elements outlined within the template into your design. All applicants are required to upload Building Construction Plans and specifications.

requirements.item: Single-Line Diagram showing complete rating information of the existing electrical system
requirements.quote: Show the existing electrical system's complete rating information for the purpose of determining adequate interconnection of the PV system.

requirements.item: Manufacturer's specifications for PV modules, racking, inverters, batteries/ESS, and meter
requirements.quote: Provide the manufacturer's specifications for the proposed PV modules, racking, inverter(s), batteries/ESS, and meter.

requirements.item: Plans stamped and signed by CA Civil/Electrical Engineer or C-10, B, or C-46 contractor
requirements.quote: PV or batteries/ESS plans may be stamped and signed by a California registered Civil or Electrical Engineer or a licensed Electrical Contractor (C-10 License), General Contractor (B License) or Solar Contractor (C-46 License) who is responsible for the design and installation of the system.

requirements.item: Incorporate Residential Solar PV Project Plan Template elements into design
requirements.quote: Review the Residential Solar PV Project Plan Template and incorporate all elements outlined within the template into your design.

requirements.item: Upload Building Construction Plans and specifications in PDF format
requirements.quote: All applicants are required to upload Building Construction Plans and specifications. NOTE: The documents must be in PDF format.

sheet_requirements.signature_or_stamp: CA Civil/Electrical Engineer or C-10, B, or C-46 contractor; CA Electrical Engineer or C-10 required if panel upgrade is proposed
sheet_requirements.quote: When an electrical panel upgrade is proposed, a California-registered Electrical Engineer or a C-10 must sign and stamp the plans.

local_rules.rule: Residential rooftop PV permit may include panel upgrade up to 320 amps, ESS up to 38.4 kWh (20 kWh max per unit), and inverter-integrated EV charger
local_rules.quote: Along with the PV installation, the following work may be included: A panel upgrade of up to 320 amps. An energy storage system of up to 38.4 kWh, with each unit not exceeding 20 kWh. An Inverter-integrated electric vehicle (EV) charger.

local_rules.rule: System is not approved to energize until SDG&E approval is obtained after City final inspection
local_rules.quote: After receiving final inspection approval for all related City of San Diego Approvals (permits), San Diego Gas and Electric (SDG&E) will be notified. The system is not approved to energize until SDG&E approval is obtained.

local_rules.rule: PV permit scope may include panel upgrade up to 320A and ESS up to 38.4 kWh
local_rules.quote: The scope can include the following scope of work in addition to PV installation: * Panel upgrades up to 320 amps. * An energy storage system up to 38.4 kWh with each unit no greater than 20 kWh.
